authorizationSource: Explicit interactive user directive: do not request approval again; record the M2 implementation proposal as approved.

firstSkill.name: Echo
firstSkill.contract: Repeat the original immutable locked attack exactly once after the configured delay; never retarget; cancel queued work on source death, restart, teardown, or invalidation; allocate an independent damage-ledger identity.

firstObstacle.name: Static non-damaging line-of-fire pillar
firstObstacle.contract: Reuse authoritative World collision, create at least two readable routes, stop Archer sweeps and presentation at the same endpoint, and add no contact damage, movement, destruction, or trap behavior.

characterDirection.benchmark: Original modern anime ensemble appeal using memorable silhouettes, contrasting personalities, relationship hooks, and decision-timed portraits without copying proprietary characters.
characterDirection.player: Rivella, age 22, a cynical former saint who overblesses enemies instead of attacking directly.
rivals: Vera, age 24, a red-lightning charge knight mapped to Dasher behavior.
Lume, age 23, an eclipse archer mapped to locked projectile and Echo behavior.
Moko, a non-human cursed-doll swarm mapped to Minion behavior.
Atra, a non-human ancient guardian whose core and posture express emotion.
characterDirection.presentation: Pixel-art combat sprites retain authoritative readability; high-resolution cel-anime portraits and expression sets appear only at first encounter, blessing choice, victory, and defeat.

roomScope.purpose: Teach Echo timing and the second-lane decision without a new obstacle.
Teach the static pillar route choice before one bounded Echo-plus-pillar composition.

assets: Rivella, Vera, Lume, Moko, and Atra original key visuals, four-expression portrait sets, and signature-prop sheets
Echo status icon and repeat telegraph/VFX from the provenance-recorded M2 resource set
Static pillar and matching floor/environment sprites from the provenance-recorded M2 resource set
acceptanceEvidence: Focused EditMode contract and lifecycle tests
Focused PlayMode Echo, obstacle, cancellation, restart, wall-stop, and composition tests
Supported-browser runtime QA with every measured one-second bucket at or above 45 FPS
Fresh no-coaching playtest observations separated from interpretation
Unaided testers can distinguish the protagonist and two major rivals by name or visual motif and connect each rival's personality to its attack habit

excluded: Direct player attacks or damaging player skills
Cliffs, traps, destructibles, residue, or final encounter
gateBoundary: This approval never creates, replaces, signs, or implies M2EntryGate PASS. M2 runtime, scene, prefab, gameplay-data, and resource binding may begin only after an independently validated externally RSA-SHA256-signed user M2EntryGate PASS exists.
